title: 土豆退婚流（纯对话版）分镜表 v1
notes: Step 5 shotlist draft v1 (猎奇线, 2026-10-01). Script: E:/program/1project/video/projects/猎奇/episodes/tudou/story/tudou_tuihun_script.md (定稿, 28 lines, no narrator), used word for word; split lines are marked line_part. duration_hint_sec = Hanzi/5.5 + 0.3 (the 0.3 only on the last part of a split line); real durations come from the VO that passes vo_gate. profile profiles/lieqi.yaml is registered for multi-voice dialogue. Extra per-shot fields (act, speaker, voice, characters_in_frame, location, camera, action_zh, motion_prompt_en, i2v_method, props) are ignored by current scripts (schema allows additionalProperties). Character refs are three-view sheets (absolute paths, project not under kepu-pipeline/projects). cucumber_heir sheet shows a luxury-brand-like monogram tracksuit and logo sneakers: every prompt overrides it to a plain polka-dot tracksuit, no logos. Ending: machinery and chips only, no blood. Canonical pipeline format is JSON (scripts json.loads the shotlist): shotlist_v1.json is generated from the same data.
